ModMetaData.name: RimWorld Loading Optimizer (RLO)
ModMetaData.author: Aruclya
ModMetaData.description:
RimWorld Loading Optimizer makes RimWorld load faster and use less memory when you play with a lot of mods. It does not add, remove or change any content: your mods, defs and saves stay exactly the same.
What it does:
- Speeds up the part of loading where mods patch each other's files. - Reads textures from disk ahead of time, so the game does not have to wait for them. - Remembers work from the previous start (for example the combined texture sheets) and reuses it when nothing changed. - Frees textures that another mod replaces and that can never be shown. - Streams medium-sized sound files from disk, as the game already does for large ones. - Speeds up slow startup code in the base game. - Optional extra support for a number of popular mods, switched on per mod in Mod Settings (off by default). - Shows a small bar on the loading screen while it is active.
Every part can be switched off separately in Mod Settings. Mod Settings also has a button that measures the difference on your own PC (two restarts).
Load RimWorld Loading Optimizer directly after Harmony.
